dungarees.alt: File:John Miller 1937 drawing of Amish village ghost bridge in Pinecraft Sarasota Florida.jpg
dungarees.by: My grandfather, John Miller was a railroad worker in Florida. He drew this picture of a local Sarasota legend in 1937. The railroad workers would tell this story to kids who would mess around the bridge in order to scare them away. I am his descendent and have ownership of image and authorize it for commons.
